id.description: Unique slug, used in page links

short.description: One-line descriptor shown under the title

kind.description: Treaty, Statute, Regulation, Executive order, Recommendation, Industry body, etc.

status_note.description: Dates, phases and what to check for updates

year.description: Year the instrument or process began. Omit if the reference material gives no clear year.

approach.description: One-line regulatory-approach label, used on the National and regional page

sponsors.description: Lead sponsors or co-sponsors, mainly for UN resolutions — a short label, or a list of names

un_track.description: Which UN resolution track this belongs to, e.g. civilian, laws, military_domain

votes.description: Vote tally, mainly for UN resolutions — free text, or a breakdown by body

sections.description: ids of site/data/sections.json sections this entry is featured in

url.description: Primary source (official text or official page)

verify.description: True when status changes quickly and needs a fresh check

last_verified.description: Date a maintainer last checked the entry against the primary source

core_focus.description: One or two sentences on what the instrument actually regulates; shown in the register table

country_code.description: ISO-style country/union code used for flags and the map view (EU, US, CN...). Use INT, UN or ASEAN for multi-state instruments.
